- **[DS-T2-003](DS-T2-003-the-polite-collector/README.md): The Polite Collector: Ethical, Change-Aware Collection from a Public Procurement Portal.** Design and build a web collector for a mock state e-procurement portal that honours RFC 9309 robots rules, crawl delays and the terms, detects amendments and withdrawals cheaply with conditional requests, raises schema-drift alarms instead of writing nulls, and is measured against a naive baseline.
- **[DS-T2-004](DS-T2-004-rain-grain-and-granularity/README.md): Rain, Grain and Granularity: Fusing Open Climate, Crop and Development Data at Mismatched Scales.** Acquire NASA POWER daily climate, FAOSTAT national crop statistics and World Bank indicators for Nigeria, align them with tested rules for seasons, coverage, flags and trends, and compare at least four alignment designs against a baseline to show how robust any climate-yield conclusion really is.
